question: Every study since v0.3 averages over an equal number of patients per subtype. If the gap varies by subtype, what does that averaging do to the headline?
estimand: Mean MCTS-minus-NCCN utility gap over the v1.2 forty patients, under (a) the equal-per-subtype weights the sample was drawn with and (b) the subtype mix of the held-out test split it was drawn from.
scope_warning: Direct standardisation over four strata of ten patients. Exploratory; not a population estimate, and still a synthetic simulator.

population_reference.source: held-out OS test split, complete-record patients
